The '''Praesitlyn system''' in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]].

==History==
The Praesitlyn system seceded with the entire Sluis sector from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN49" />
